## Task
Fix the code under `taskflow/` (dir: `/tmp/obench-cell-t_sqjoor/bench_opencode_taskflow__hk4busk`) so `python3 -m unittest` passes all 25 tests. Tests are the spec and must not be modified. Bugs are logic errors where docstrings describe correct behavior; some bugs mask others, so re-run after each round.

## Fixes applied so far (via sed)
1. **`taskflow/queue.py`** `_Entry.sort_key`: `(self.seq, -self.priority)` → `(-self.priority, self.seq)`.
2. **`taskflow/retry.py`** `should_retry`: `attempts_made < self.max_attempts - 1` → `attempts_made < self.max_attempts`.
3. **`taskflow/resources.py`** `ResourcePool.release`: `self.used -= 1` → `self.used -= cost`.
4. **`taskflow/events.py`** `_prefix_matches`: `prefix.startswith(topic + ".")` → `topic.startswith(prefix + ".")`.
5. **`taskflow/config.py`** `deep_merge`: `deep_merge(value, result[key])` → `deep_merge(result[key], value)`.

After these, 8 failures remained (all in `tests/test_pipelines.py`): diamond_transitive_skip, full_pipeline_retry_priority_resources, history_failed_and_skipped_sets, history_outcome_counts_mixed, priority_dispatch_order, priority_four_way_batch, priority_respected_after_dependency, transitive_skip_chain.

## Diagnosed but not yet applied
- **`taskflow/statemachine.py`** `batch_order_ok`: returns `current_priority >= prev_priority`; docstring says each admitted task must have priority ≤ previous → should be `return current_priority <= prev_priority`. (Causes priority tests and full pipeline to fail — scheduler `_admit` fails the run on IllegalTransition.)
- **`taskflow/scheduler.py`** `_cascade_skip`: iterates `self.dag.dependents(failed_run.id)` (direct only); docstring says transitive → use `self.dag.transitive_dependents(failed_run.id)` (which exists in `dag.py`, BFS, looks correct). Fixes skip-chain/diamond/history skipped tests.

## Next steps
Apply the two fixes above, re-run `python3 -m unittest`, and investigate any remaining failures (possibly in `runner.py`, `history.py` — e.g. `failed_jobs/skipped_jobs/succeeded_jobs/outcome_counts/peak_resource_usage`, report `ok()`/`run_order()`/`skipped()` — or `dag.py`, which haven't been fully read yet).
